note: Packs offered by Get more (shared/library/get-more.js): font packs (kind "font", the default) and AI model packs (kind "model", one .onnx file, used by Slop Upscale). Nothing downloads until a person clicks Download and confirms the licence and size. Each file needs its path in the Slopographic cdn repository ("cdn", served from the release tag in shared/cdn/assets.js) or an https URL on one of the hosts below (the cdn files are allowed on their own hosts, only for that repository), its exact size in bytes and its lowercase SHA-256. See shared/fonts/HANDOFF.md and upscale/HANDOFF.md.

packs.name: Barlow and Barlow Condensed
packs.description: Barlow and Barlow Condensed, static Regular to Bold, from google/fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

packs.name: Office-compatible fonts (Calibri, Cambria, Arial, Times New Roman, Courier New)
packs.description: Carlito, Caladea, Arimo, Tinos and Cousine: the same character widths as Calibri, Cambria, Arial, Times New Roman and Courier New, so text that names those fonts keeps its line breaks. Regular, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

packs.name: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (Slop Upscale, 4×)
packs.description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus from xinntao/Real-ESRGAN, converted to ONNX without changes to the weights. Runs on your device; the picture is not uploaded.

packs.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (Slop Image to 3D, depth)
packs.description: Depth Anything V2 Small (depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small, Apache-2.0), ONNX export from onnx-community with int8 weight quantisation. Estimates depth from one picture. Runs on your device; the picture is not uploaded.
